# GPUStack Operator

> GPUStack Operator discovers accelerators, organizes capacity into pools, and schedules Kubernetes workloads for interactive use and model serving.

Documentation version: main. Source revision: 5138fe30e8ecf48c32d7c54d0ab1e84e70fafeff.
These pages come from the repository's docs/ sources. For version-specific behavior, use the
documentation and code for your release. This index routes questions; follow its links for evidence.

## Getting Started

- [Architecture](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/getting-started/architecture/index.md): Scheduling chain, workload flow, and core vocabulary
- [Vendor Prerequisites](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/getting-started/vendor-prerequisites/index.md): Third-party dependencies and per-vendor driver preparation

## Walkthroughs

- [Walkthroughs](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/index.md): Select a complete cross-module example
- [Heterogeneous Devices Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/devices/scheduling/index.md): Follow a recorded accelerator scheduling run
- [RDMA Networking Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/rdma/network-endpoints/index.md): Request and verify RDMA endpoints and NUMA alignment
- [Hierarchical Placement Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/topology/hierarchical-placement/index.md): Place serving replicas across zones and racks
- [Shared Cache Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/kv-cache/shared-cache/index.md): Stand up a shared KV cache from backend to workload
- [Model Prefetch Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-delivery/prefetch/index.md): Cache model weights and verify captured CR status
- [Model Deployment Walkthroughs](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/index.md): Select a serving topology, hardware, and `AcceleratorType` example
- [Prefill and Decode Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/prefill-decode/index.md): Deploy H100 prefill and decode roles with tested TCP transfer
- [Encode, Prefill and Decode Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/encode-prefill-decode/index.md): Deploy encode, prefill, and decode roles for multimodal serving
- [Elastic EP Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/elastic-ep/index.md): Expand an H100 collective from four to eight GPUs in place
- [External DP Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/external-dp/index.md): Deploy four fixed H100 ranks and verify Router coverage
- [Model Deployment Scaling Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/scaling/index.md): Configure Shadow and Active scaling, algorithms, and retirement
- [Online Runtime Control Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/runtime-control/index.md): Tune vLLM and SGLang live, pause roles, and resize Elastic EP
- [Multi-Host Serving Walkthrough](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/walkthroughs/model-deployment/multi-host/index.md): Scale serving models across multiple GPU nodes

## Heterogeneous Devices

- [Heterogeneous Devices](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/devices/index.md): Choose an accelerator request mode
- [Preflight Checks](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/devices/preflight/index.md): Validate node health before installation
- [Accelerator Requests](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/devices/requests/index.md): Look up resource keys and request rules
- [NVIDIA MIG Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/devices/nvidia-mig/index.md): Enable and recover NVIDIA MIG partitions
- [Hygon MIG Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/devices/hygon-mig/index.md): Enable and recover Hygon partitions
- [T-Head MIG Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/devices/thead-mig/index.md): Enable and recover T-Head partitions

## RDMA Networking

- [RDMA Networking](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/rdma/index.md): Configure RDMA-backed workloads
- [RDMA Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/rdma/operations/index.md): Request and verify RDMA endpoints and TopologyManager

## Topology

- [Topology](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/topology/index.md): Constrain workload placement by topology domain
- [Topology-Aware Scheduling Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/topology/operations/index.md): Enable Topograph and diagnose pending placement

## KV Cache

- [KV Cache](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/kv-cache/index.md): Deploy shared inference prefix caches
- [KV Cache Backend](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/kv-cache/backend/index.md): Configure Mooncake cache backends and capacity
- [KV Cache Pools and Bindings](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/kv-cache/pool/index.md): Grant cache reuse domains and enforce pool quotas
- [KV Cache Election and Failover](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/kv-cache/leader/index.md): Operate leader election, probes, and failover
- [KV Cache Local Disk Tier](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/kv-cache/local-disk-tier/index.md): Configure local disk cache buckets, eviction, and disk-heavy nodes

## Model Delivery

- [Model Delivery](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-delivery/index.md): Select how model weights reach workloads
- [Model Artifact](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-delivery/artifact/index.md): Resolve, verify, and mount weights from Hub, PVC, or OCI images
- [Model Prefetch](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-delivery/prefetch/index.md): Warm weights ahead of launch and sync cached trees between nodes
- [Remote Weight Delivery](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-delivery/remote/index.md): Load weights over the network from prepared sources
- [Model Store Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-delivery/operations/index.md): Operate node cache watermarks, placement, and cleanup

## Model Deployment

- [Model Deployment](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/index.md): Deploy managed model serving workloads
- [Configuration](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/configuration/index.md): Configure roles, resources, overrides, and placement
- [Engine Compatibility](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/engine-versions/index.md): Check engine releases, store versions, and transports
- [Prefill and Decode](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/prefill-decode/index.md): Pair disaggregated prefill and decode roles
- [Prefill and Decode Benchmark](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/prefill-decode-benchmark/index.md): Compare equal-GPU H100 aggregated and disaggregated serving
- [Encode, Prefill and Decode](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/encode-prefill-decode/index.md): Disaggregate encode, prefill, and decode roles
- [Encode, Prefill and Decode Benchmark](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/encode-prefill-decode-benchmark/index.md): Compare EPD, prefill/decode, and aggregated throughput
- [Elastic EP](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/elastic-ep/index.md): Resize an expert-parallel collective in place
- [Elastic EP Benchmark](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/elastic-ep-benchmark/index.md): Measure four- to eight-GPU H100 live expansion
- [External DP](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/external-dp/index.md): Serve a fixed data-parallel group behind a managed router
- [External DP Benchmark](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/external-dp-benchmark/index.md): Compare External DP ranks against wide tensor parallelism
- [Model Deployment Scaling](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/scaling/index.md): Plan replica counts from serving signals and capacity priors
- [Model Deployment Scaling Benchmark](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/scaling-benchmark/index.md): Measure H100 and H200 scaling latency and limits
- [Model Deployment Forger](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/forger/index.md): Automate closed-loop kernel probing, forging, and canary rollout
- [Online Runtime Control](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/runtime-control/index.md): Tune serving parameters, pause roles, and isolate managed routers live
- [Model Deployment Routing](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/model-deployment/routing/index.md): Configure routing policies and verify router serving

## GPU Instances

- [GPU Instances](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/instances/index.md): Launch accelerator-backed container workspaces and size unit resources
- [GPU Instance Configuration](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/instances/configuration/index.md): Configure SSH access, volumes, node pinning, and custom instance types
- [GPU Instance Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/modules/instances/operations/index.md): Operate stop/start lifecycles, network isolation, metrics, and logs

## Operations

- [Installation Modes](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/operate/installation-modes/index.md): Choose Helm chart mode or image mode
- [High Availability Operations](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/operate/high-availability/index.md): Configure control-plane replicas and failover
- [Migrating from v0.5.x](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/operate/migration/from-v0.5/index.md): Upgrade across the queue refactor
- [Migrating to Bundled Subcharts](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/operate/migration/bundled-subcharts/index.md): Transfer ownership to bundled subcharts
- [Upgrading to an Enforced Binding Dtype](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/operate/migration/enforced-binding-dtype/index.md): Verify binding dtypes before upgrading
- [Migration Troubleshooting](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/docs/operate/migration/troubleshooting/index.md): Recover stuck upgrades and namespace deletions

## Reference

- [LLM Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/README.md): Navigate flat reference contracts, exact aliases, and evidence labels
- [Command Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/commands.md): Look up `gpustack-operator` subcommands, flags, and exit codes
- [Settings & Environment Variables](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/settings.md): Look up `Setting` resources and `GPUSTACK_*` variables
- [Instance Type Unit Resources Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/instance-type-unit-resources.md): Look up CPU and memory unit presets
- [Ascend A5 Matrix](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/ascend-a5-matrix.md): Look up Ascend A5 UB, Host RoCE and mount matrices
- [Device Discovery](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/devices-discovery.md): Trace hardware detection, slicing, and allocation
- [Scheduling Chain](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/devices-scheduling.md): Map node capacity labels to Kueue queues
- [Admission](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/devices-admission.md): Review webhook checks and admission gates
- [NVIDIA MIG Transcripts](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/devices-mig-transcripts.md): Review recorded three-configuration H100 MIG transcripts
- [Devices Scheduling Capture](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/devices-scheduling-capture.md): Review captured multi-object scheduling YAML dumps
- [Network Topology](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/rdma-network-topology.md): Inspect NIC discovery, PCI roots, and link states
- [Topology-Aware Scheduling](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/topology-scheduling.md): Map topology snapshots into Kueue TAS placement
- [KV Cache Backend Internals](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/kv-cache-backend-internals.md): Inspect Mooncake rendering, condition algebra and teardown
- [KV Cache Injection Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/kv-cache-injection.md): Attach a Pod to a KV cache pool
- [Model Artifact API](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-delivery-artifact-api.md): Query public artifact and node cache APIs
- [Node Model Store](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-delivery-node-store.md): Inspect node cache state, CSI mounts, and collection
- [Remote Weight Delivery Internals](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-delivery-remote-internals.md): Inspect source arithmetic, reader protocol and ModelExpress env
- [Model Deployment Internals](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-internals.md): Inspect owned keys, render versions and refusal catalog
- [Parameters](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-parameters.md): Inspect synthesized engine, router, and transfer flags
- [Model Deployment Metrics](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-metrics.md): Inspect serving, role, and router Prometheus series
- [Model Deployment Status](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-status.md): Diagnose conditions, retirements, and scaler annotations
- [Model Deployment Shutdown](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-shutdown.md): Follow replica retirement, drain, and unadmitted removal
- [Scaling Internals](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-scaling-internals.md): Inspect prior qualification, normalization and status schemas
- [Model Deployment Scaling Simulation](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-scaling-simulation.md): Compare scaler algorithms on identical synthetic traffic
- [Model Deployment Forger Internals](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/model-deployment-forger-internals.md): Inspect `LocalKernelKey`, FlashInfer schemas, `/ingest/v1/trees`, and pin union
- [Instance Metrics Reference](https://docs.gpustack.ai/gpustack-operator/main/reference/instances-metrics.md): Inspect per-instance accelerator utilization metrics
